summary: Re-bound the Phase 3 UX result to orchestrator-confirmed current HEAD 9e406e8ccf2c531b8a24fb18abe3f1398fc25fc4. The unchanged browser script and source retain the prior evidence. nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: The Phaser 2D game has an empty accessibility snapshot because the interface renders in a canvas. The screenshots show game content, but the canvas does not expose that content to assistive technology. This remains a nonblocking limitation.

The orchestrator reports that `git diff --stat 1eefa25d 9e406e8ccf2c531b8a24fb18abe3f1398fc25fc4 -- src scripts` printed nothing. This is orchestrator-supplied evidence; this role did not run shell commands.
The orchestrator reports intervening commits 437bcb2d (test-only skip), f9cacede (plan and tech-debt records), and 9e406e8c (run records).

Read out/old-browser/check.json: spellweavers-run started; two accepted actions were ArrowRight and ArrowLeft; the 1500 ms negative control reports changed false; errors is empty; all four built-ins are undefined in the page.

Opened both current screenshots. The start image shows the game prompt, answer choices, HUD, forest scene, and player. The move image shows sentence progress, a selected answer, and a changed game scene.

Read scripts/old-browser-check.mjs. It deletes and checks the four built-ins, waits for the demo and mounted Phaser game, and verifies that the local port belongs to the spawned Vite process tree. These checks reject a blank page and a foreign server.

The script counts a move when a page input event and a player-action field change occur together. The quiet control checks for action-field changes without input. However, TD-49 records a contrived harness path that can block game handlers or call the game's auto hook. The orchestrator has classified A3-F6 and ADV3-F2 as tech debt; this result does not claim proof that the game itself processed the input.

Read green-p3-t7r2.log and the round 2 probes. The harness-score probe and foreign-server probe failed as expected. The Green run passed with an owned server, a mounted game, accepted inputs, and no recorded errors.

The browser panel opened the supplied URL in display-only mode. It did not provide an interactive snapshot, so this re-bind relies on the captured screenshots and run artifacts rather than a new live interaction.
The Phaser accessibility tree remains empty. No broader visual-quality or audible-quality claim is made.
